title: Lines priced before the release are in Before tiers
refs: SV-11718 (Reports Story 1 S1-E4 Reports Story 3 S3-R1),SV-11701 (Story 12 S12-R6)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Use staging, where invoices from before the release are kept.
  • Note the date the release reached staging.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick Custom range in the Date filter.
  3. Type a range that ends before the release reached staging (for example the month before).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • From and To boxes show.

Step 3:

  • Every invoiced part line of that range is in one row, Before tiers.
  • No tier, Fixed price, Fixed line total or Manual row shows.
  • The row reads Before tiers, with no number.
